answer_1.quote: We introduce a new task of party-specific extractive summarization of important obligations, entitlements, and prohibitions in legal contracts; ... we build a pipeline-based extractive summarization system (CONTRASUM) for the proposed task.
answer_1.outputs: Extractive summaries of obligations, entitlements, and prohibitions for a specified party

answer_2.quote: We report macro-averaged Precision, Recall, and F1 scores ... We also report Precision@k, Recall@k, F1@k ... Mean Average Precision (MAP), and Normalized Discounted Cumulative Gain (NDCG) ... We also report ROUGE-1/2/L scores ...

answer_4.quote: In addition to automatic evaluation, we also give contracts along with their party-specific summaries ... to legal experts for human evaluation.
answer_4.guideline: They are asked to rate the summaries for each category on a 5-point scale as per: (1) informativeness; (2) usefulness; (3) accuracy of categorization; (4) redundancy, and (5) accuracy of importance ranking. In addition, we ask them to rate the overall quality of a summary on a 10-point scale.
